question: 'Yakshagana', the famous folk dance, is associated with which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Yakshagana** is a traditional theatre form of Karnataka, primarily performed in the coastal districts.
 
• This art form combines **dance, music, dialogue, costume, make-up, and stage techniques** with a unique style and form.
 
• The performances typically depict stories from Indian epics like the **Mahabharata** and **Ramayana**.
 
• Yakshagana is performed in the **Kannada and Tulu** languages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Costumes and Makeup:** Yakshagana performers wear elaborate costumes and makeup, which are essential elements of the performance, giving it a vibrant and colorful appearance.
 
• **Musical Instruments:** The music in Yakshagana is provided by traditional instruments such as the chenda, maddale, harmonium, and chengila.
 
• **Types of Yakshagana:** There are two main styles of Yakshagana: Badagu Thittu (northern style) and Tenkutittu (southern style), which differ in presentation, costumes, and dance forms.
 
• **Historical Significance:** Yakshagana has a history dating back over 400 years and is believed to have evolved from pre-classical music and theatre art forms.
 
• **Modern Adaptations:** While traditionally performed overnight, modern Yakshagana performances have been adapted to fit shorter durations to cater to contemporary audiences.
